name: Brighid
description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Brighid is a Legendary Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding twin Blade Whips with the Fire Element. Having lived countless years, she brings great wisdom, skill, and Fire mastery. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
